summary: Reads three fields of the receiver (this+0x11C, this+0x124, this+0x12C) and writes each to a caller-supplied output pointer (a2, a3, a4), skipping any output pointer that is null. Returns a4, the third output pointer. Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 (004FCEE0).

operations.description: Null-check a2; the write to *a2 is skipped when a2 is null.
Write this[0x11C] into *a2 when a2 is non-null.
Null-check a3; the write to *a3 is skipped when a3 is null.
Write this[0x124] into *a3 when a3 is non-null.
Null-check a4; the write to *a4 is skipped when a4 is null.
Write this[0x12C] into *a4 when a4 is non-null.
Return a4 (the third output pointer) regardless of whether it was written.
Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 (004FCEE0) to read receiver state into caller-owned output slots.
